name: game-kit
description: The first-person player and reusable HUD helpers for Volt 3D games: mouse look, walking, running, crouching, jumping, gravity, head bob, solid boxes, and a ten-slot 1–9/0 and mouse-wheel player hotbar. World Studio fills the hotbar from its Player > Backpack > Hotbar section.

snippets.label: Game kit (player, collision, hotbar)
snippets.description: Import with `import "game.volt"`. Includes first-person movement, collision and the default ten-slot player hotbar.
